notes: Art Commission minutes 1970-1983. Resolutions now run 'Resolution #1975-279 <title> RESOLVED, That this Commission does hereby approve ...'; 1,940 split out of the 14 volumes (res8.py). Architects are almost never named, so the yield is the murals, works of art and a few civic building approvals of the Neighborhood Arts Program and CETA years, curated by hand. Every meeting date checked against the 'was held on' line or the page headers (A/C minutes m/d/yy; Minutes (d Month yyyy) from 1981).

coverage.remaining: Not placed (no page, or site uncertain): murals at Valencia Gardens (George Mead, 1975-77), Sunnydale (1654 Sunnydale Avenue), Ping Yuen (Josie Grant, 1976-80), North Beach housing (1976-80), Marcus Garvey Square, Watoto Weusi School (2400 Post), the Puerto Rican Community Center (3249A Mission), the South of Market Health Center, the WAPAC building, Red Shield playground, the Twin Peaks radio tower, the Filipino Education Center, 16th Street walls (3141, 3166, Hoff), One Holland Court, Galeria de la Raza, Saint Patrick's day care; Fran Valesco's mural for 'Holly Court' at 1095 Connecticut Street (that address is Potrero Terrace, so not placed); Firehouse 42 sculpture (Henri-Marie Rose) and the Firehouse 13 competition; firehouses 3, 33, 37 and Engine 1 (Embarcadero Center), Muni Metro Rail Center and Woods motor coach facility art (no pages); school reconstructions of the 1970s (Phase I/II only, or no page); airport items, signs and encroachments skipped. Paltenghi Youth Center mural left out: its building is not certain. The 1973 stained-glass window by Robert Quagliatta for the 'Bayview Health Center (Marquis & Stoler)' is not placed: those are not the architects of the 1525 Silver health center (Hertzka and Knowles, 1966-67), so it may be another building. One 1967 resolution (David Arnold's windows for the Bayview Health Center) is included because it is the second fact that seeds 1501-1525 Silver Avenue.
